name: دار الورثة
overview: Kabour, a traditional patriarch, stubbornly refuses to sell his ancestral Riad despite the rapid urbanization and high-rise construction surrounding it. To preserve family unity, he forces his adult children and their spouses to live with him under one roof. This forced cohabitation leads to daily comedic conflicts as the family navigates financial struggles, generational clashes, and the constant battle over their potential inheritance.
